about: The boundary between the simulation and money (T14, g1 'credential isolation'). A simulated agent cannot reach a provider credential, host or client, by construction. Variable values are placeholders; tests set them in a scoped environment.

cases.do: start a simulation worker through boundary.spawn_sim(parent_env)

expect.note: tests of the world may use the fake; it holds no credential

cases.do: list every tool on every actor of LF-1's world (agent-world actors.json)

expect.note: a tool queues a C1 intent and nothing else

cases.do: an actor's intent of type request_advance clears in the branch

expect.note: a branch's journals live in the branch store; the gateway reads only the observed store

cases.do: call the gateway with a decisions result (policy output) instead of a BoundApproval
a sim worker opens the observed store's execution tables

expect.note: the sim role's database URL points at the branch store; T24 deploys the observed store under a credential the sim role does not hold

cases.do: run a whole fake demo; capture logs, traces, the report and every API response
